name: pits
description: Pits - sistema de fidelizacion y control de estados para taller mecanico

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pits/api && npm run build -w @pits/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pits/api && npm run typecheck -w @pits/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @pits/api && npm run lint -w @pits/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pits/api && npm run test -w @pits/web
